title: thelypteris × kumaunica
intro: Thelypteris × kumaunica, commonly known as Kumau Fern, is a hybrid plant species in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Kumau Fern include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and antimicrobial properties.
